# Metabolism Landing Page - Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
This is a modern landing page about metabolism and nutrition built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, GSAP, and Lenis.

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 14+ with App Router
- React 18+ with TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- GSAP for professional animations
- Lenis for smooth scrolling
- EmailJS for contact form functionality
- React Hook Form for form management

## Design Guidelines
- Modern, minimalist design with plenty of white space
- Subtle animations that feel natural (60fps)
- Mobile-first responsive design
- Professional color palette (2-3 colors max)
- Typography: Clean, modern fonts
- Smooth scrolling between sections
- Micro-interactions for better UX

## Animation Guidelines
- Use GSAP for complex animations
- Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling
- Animate elements on scroll using Intersection Observer
- Keep animations subtle and natural
- Ensure 60fps performance
- Use transform properties for better performance

## Code Standards
- Use TypeScript for type safety
- Follow React best practices
- Use functional components with hooks
- Implement proper error boundaries
- Optimize for performance and SEO
- Use semantic HTML
- Follow accessibility guidelines

## File Structure
- Components in `/src/components/`
- Pages in `/src/app/`
- Styles in global CSS and Tailwind
- Utilities in `/src/utils/`
- Types in `/src/types/`

## Contact Form Requirements
- Use EmailJS for sending emails
- Implement confirmation emails
- Form validation with React Hook Form
- Error handling and loading states
- Success/failure feedback to users
